content:
maya: RFC follow-up: propose slicing the runtime into ingest, core-exec, telemetry + a tiny orchestration facade. intent: independent deploys, clearer SLAs, smaller ownership.

sam: incremental cutover or big-bang?

maya: incremental. extract read-only interfaces, ship a compatibility shim, route small % via feature flags, ramp and retire.

chris: KV cache ownership was rough last time. plan?

maya: keep KV in core-exec initially. expose a minimal RPC for prefix hints. move ownership later once stable.

raj: observability gating is mandatory before any routing. need end-to-end traces + latency histograms.

kelly: product constraint: no customer-visible perf regressions. set per-module SLOs and an overall budget.

maya: suggested SLOs: ingest p50 < 15ms, core-exec p50 < 40ms, telem p99 < 200ms. if breached, auto-fallback to monolith.

sam: I'll implement a router circuit-breaker watching errors+latency for auto-fallback.

chris: kernel selection logic state: avoid drift by packaging it as a shared internal library both runtimes call. CI tests to catch regressions.

raj: DB schema risk: monolith hides invariants. proposal: single schema for now, service-owned namespaces for new cols, feature-flagged reads/writes.

kelly: timeline request: 6-week pilot and a rollback playbook for product.

maya: week plan: wk0 design+owners, wk1-2 extract interfaces+tracing hooks, wk3 canary core-exec 5% with enforced traces, wk4 ramp 25% + tuning, wk5 telemetry verification + drills + ramp 60%, wk6 cutover for non-critical tenants and start retiring monolith paths.

sam: add SRE signoff gates end wk3 and wk5.

raj: I'll draft the observability gate checklist (traces, tail histograms, synthetic tests).

chris: security: enforce tenant isolation, mTLS between modules, short-lived tokens, KMS for secrets.

kelly: I'll coordinate cross-team blockers and flag customers for outreach.

deploy-bot: deployment: core-exec canary: started 5% traffic on cluster-2 (job id: deploy-1768300101) :rocket:

maya: next steps: finalize RFC this week, assign owners, SRE to create checklist, infra to scope mTLS. reconvene after wk1 sync. :thumbsup:
